activities.title: Big or little
activities.intro: Look at the two pictures. One is big, one is little. Tap the one the question asks for.
activities.offScreen: Go take one big step and one little step across a room and show a grown-up.

rounds.prompt: Take a big step and a little step. Tap the big step.

activities.title: Sort by size
activities.intro: Some of these are big. Some are little. Put the big ones together and the little ones together.
activities.offScreen: Go find a big toy and a little toy of the same kind and show a grown-up.

rounds.prompt: Some stars are big. Some stars are little. Put the big ones together and the little ones together.

activities.title: First the big one, then the little one
activities.intro: Two cards show something big and something little. Put them in order: first, then.
activities.offScreen: Go stack a big block, then a little block on top, and show a grown-up.

rounds.prompt: First the big block. Then the little block. Put the cards in that order.
First the little cup. Then the big cup. Put the cards in that order.
First the big star. Then the little star. Put the cards in that order.

parentCard.title: Big and little
steps: Get a pile of blocks in two sizes, some big and some little.
Ask them to take one big step across the room, then one little step.
Build a big tower with the bigger blocks and a little tower with the smaller blocks, side by side.
Ask them to point to the big tower, then point to the little tower.
Take turns: they call out big or little, and you both do a big step or a little step together.
notice: Do they take a genuinely bigger step for big and a smaller one for little, or are the two about the same?
Do they point to the right tower when you ask, without you pointing first?
